metadata.title: Can Multiple AI Agents Work Better Than One?
metadata.note: STEM/AI topic-of-interest video on Agent Orchestration and Autonomous Systems. Covers: what distinguishes an 'agent' from a single LLM call (planning, tool use, iteration), what orchestration means (a controller routing work across specialized agents), the coordination pipeline, the real benefits (specialization, parallelism), and the honest risk (autonomy compounds errors across steps, so more autonomy needs more oversight, not less). Built using the same proven pattern set as prior videos: folderLabel set explicitly on ClaudeComposerAsk beats (@HumanitariansAI), OutroCTA used instead of ClaudeTitleOutro, BLUF lines kept short to avoid edge-bleed, no stale sparse_by_design flags except the legitimate BrutalistHesitantWriter typing-beat exemption.
